<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Armonia Lashes - Tu mirada, tu poder</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Jost:wght@200;300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --cream: #EDE0D0;
    --warm-white: #FFFFFF;
    --rose-dust: #B5766A;
    --deep-rose: #8B3E2F;
    --mocha: #3B1F18;
    --gold: #A8832A;
    --gold-light: #D4B870;
    --charcoal: #1A0F0A;
    --mid: #5C3A30;
    --accent: #C9622A;
  }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    background: var(--warm-white);
    color: var(--charcoal);
    font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 300;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* NAV */
  nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 20px 48px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.96);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(168,131,42,0.25);
  }
  .nav-logo {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 1.55rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: var(--mocha);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .nav-logo span { color: var(--gold); }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 36px; list-style: none; }
  .nav-links a {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--mid);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.3s;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--deep-rose); }

  /* HERO */
  .hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .hero-left {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
    padding: 140px 64px 80px 80px;
    position: relative; z-index: 2;
  }
  .hero-tag {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.35em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .hero-tag::before {
    content: '';
    display: block; width: 36px; height: 1px;
    background: var(--gold);
  }
  .hero-title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 5.5vw, 5.6rem);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.06;
    color: var(--mocha);
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }
  .hero-title em { font-style: italic; color: var(--deep-rose); }
  .hero-sub {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: var(--mid);
    max-width: 400px;
    margin-bottom: 52px;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .hero-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; }
  .btn-ghost {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.22em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--mocha);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold);
    padding-bottom: 3px;
    transition: color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--deep-rose); border-color: var(--deep-rose); }
  .hero-right {
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--cream);
  }
  .hero-illustration {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .eye-art {
    width: 70%; max-width: 440px;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp 1.2s ease 0.4s forwards;
  }
  .hero-badge {
    position: absolute; bottom: 60px; left: -20px;
    background: var(--mocha);
    color: var(--gold-light);
    padding: 20px 28px;
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-style: italic;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    max-width: 200px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    z-index: 3;
  }
  .hero-deco {
    position: absolute; top: 80px; right: 40px;
    width: 90px; height: 90px;
    border: 1px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 50%;
    opacity: 0.5;
  }
  .hero-deco::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--rose-dust);
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  /* STATS */
  .stats {
    background: var(--mocha);
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    border-top: 2px solid var(--gold);
  }
  .stat-item {
    padding: 40px 48px;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(168,131,42,0.3);
    text-align: center;
  }
  .stat-item:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .stat-num {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 2.8rem;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    font-weight: 300;
    display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .stat-label {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.22em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #D4B870;
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  /* SECTIONS */
  section { padding: 100px 80px; }
  .section-tag {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.35em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .section-tag::before {
    content: '';
    display: block; width: 28px; height: 2px;
    background: var(--gold);
  }
  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 3.4rem);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.15;
    color: var(--mocha);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .section-title em { font-style: italic; color: var(--deep-rose); }

  /* NOSOTRAS */
  .nosotras {
    background: var(--warm-white);
    padding: 100px 80px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 80px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .nosotras-left {}
  .nosotras-lead {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    line-height: 1.85;
    color: var(--mid);
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .nosotras-story {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.9;
    color: var(--mid);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .nosotras-firma {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--deep-rose);
    margin-top: 32px;
  }
  .nosotras-right {
    background: var(--cream);
    padding: 52px 44px;
    border-left: 4px solid var(--gold);
    position: relative;
  }
  .nosotras-quote {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 1.7rem;
    font-style: italic;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--mocha);
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .nosotras-values {
    list-style: none;
    margin-top: 28px;
  }
  .nosotras-values li {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    color: var(--mid);
    padding: 10px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(168,131,42,0.2);
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .nosotras-values li::before {
    content: '';
    display: block; width: 20px; height: 2px;
    background: var(--gold);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* DIFERENCIADORES */
  .diferenciadores { background: var(--cream); padding: 100px 80px; }
  .dif-header { max-width: 520px; margin-bottom: 70px; }
  .dif-lead { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--mid); font-weight: 400; }
  .dif-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 2px;
    background: rgba(59,31,24,0.12);
  }
  .dif-card {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    padding: 52px 40px;
    position: relative;
    transition: transform 0.3s;
  }
  .dif-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); }
  .dif-num {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 4.5rem;
    color: rgba(168,131,42,0.25);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    display: block;
  }
  .dif-card h3 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--mocha);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .dif-card p { font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--mid); font-weight: 400; }
  .dif-line {
    position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0;
    height: 3px; width: 0;
    background: var(--gold);
    transition: width 0.4s ease;
  }
  .dif-card:hover .dif-line { width: 100%; }

  /* SERVICIOS */
  .servicios-section { background: #FFFFFF; padding: 100px 80px; }
  .servicios-intro { max-width: 580px; margin-bottom: 60px; }
  .servicios-intro p { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--mid); font-weight: 400; }
  .servicios-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 2px;
    background: rgba(59,31,24,0.1);
  }
  .serv-card {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    padding: 44px 36px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    transition: background 0.3s;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .serv-card:hover { background: #FDFAF6; }
  .serv-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 3px; height: 0;
    background: var(--gold);
    transition: height 0.4s ease;
  }
  .serv-card:hover::before { height: 100%; }
  .serv-num {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    display: block;
  }
  .serv-card h3 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--mocha);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  .serv-card p { font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--mid); flex: 1; font-weight: 400; }
  .serv-sub {
    list-style: none;
    margin-top: 20px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(168,131,42,0.2);
    padding-top: 16px;
  }
  .serv-sub li {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: var(--mid);
    padding: 5px 0;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .serv-sub li::before {
    content: '';
    display: block; width: 12px; height: 1px;
    background: var(--gold);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .serv-cta {
    margin-top: 60px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .btn-primary {
    font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.22em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    background: var(--mocha);
    border: none; padding: 18px 44px;
    cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s;
    text-decoration: none; display: inline-block;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--deep-rose); transform: translateY(-2px); }

  /* PROPUESTA */
  .propuesta {
    background: var(--mocha);
    color: var(--cream);
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .prop-left { padding: 100px 80px; }
  .prop-left .section-tag { color: var(--gold-light); }
  .prop-left .section-tag::before { background: var(--gold-light); }
  .prop-left .section-title { color: #FFFFFF; }
  .prop-left .section-title em { color: #D4B870; }
  .prop-text {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.9;
    color: rgba(237,224,208,0.85);
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .prop-right {
    background: var(--deep-rose);
    padding: 100px 80px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
  }
  .slogan-big {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
    font-style: italic;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    line-height: 1.2;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }
  .slogan-sub {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
    max-width: 340px;
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  /* REDES */
  .redes { background: var(--cream); padding: 100px 80px; }
  .redes-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
    margin-top: 60px;
    max-width: 800px;
  }
  .red-card {
    border: 2px solid rgba(168,131,42,0.3);
    padding: 44px 36px;
    background: #FFFFFF;
    transition: border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
  }
  .red-card:hover { border-color: var(--gold); transform: translateY(-3px); }
  .red-icon { margin-bottom: 20px; display: block; line-height: 0; }
  .red-card h3 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    color: var(--mocha);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .red-purpose {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .red-card p { font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--mid); font-weight: 400; }
  .red-list { list-style: none; margin-top: 20px; }
  .red-list li {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--mid);
    padding: 7px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(168,131,42,0.15);
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .red-list li::before { content: ''; display:block; width:14px; height:1px; background: var(--gold); flex-shrink:0; }

  /* CONTACTO */
  .contacto { background: var(--charcoal); padding: 100px 80px; text-align: center; }
  .contacto .section-tag { justify-content: center; color: var(--gold-light); }
  .contacto .section-tag::before { display: none; }
  .contacto .section-title { color: #FFFFFF; text-align: center; }
  .contacto .section-title em { color: #D4B870; }
  .contacto-sub {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: rgba(237,224,208,0.7);
    max-width: 480px;
    margin: 0 auto 52px;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .contacto-actions { display: flex; gap: 20px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .btn-wa {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--charcoal);
    background: var(--gold-light);
    border: none; padding: 18px 40px;
    cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s;
    text-decoration: none; display: inline-block;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .btn-wa:hover { background: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .btn-ig {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    background: transparent;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    padding: 18px 40px;
    cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s;
    text-decoration: none; display: inline-block;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .btn-ig:hover { border-color: var(--gold-light); color: var(--gold-light); }

  /* FOOTER */
  footer {
    background: var(--charcoal);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(168,131,42,0.2);
    padding: 36px 80px;
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  }
  .footer-logo {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: #FFFFFF;
  }
  .footer-logo span { color: var(--gold-light); }
  .footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: rgba(237,224,208,0.4);
  }

  /* ANIMATIONS */
  @keyframes fadeUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }
  .fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(24px);
    transition: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.7s ease;
  }
  .fade-in.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  .hero-left > * { opacity: 0; animation: fadeUp 0.9s ease forwards; }
  .hero-tag     { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
  .hero-title   { animation-delay: 0.25s; }
  .hero-sub     { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
  .hero-actions { animation-delay: 0.55s; }

  /* RESPONSIVE */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    nav { padding: 16px 20px; }
    section { padding: 64px 24px; }
    .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; }
    .hero-left { padding: 110px 24px 52px; }
    .hero-right { height: 300px; }
    .stats { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .stat-item { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(168,131,42,0.2); padding: 24px 20px; }
    .nosotras { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; padding: 64px 24px; }
    .dif-grid, .servicios-grid, .redes-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .diferenciadores { padding: 64px 24px; }
    .servicios-section { padding: 64px 24px; }
    .propuesta { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .prop-left, .prop-right { padding: 64px 24px; }
    .redes { padding: 64px 24px; }
    .contacto { padding: 64px 24px; }
    footer { padding: 24px 20px; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; text-align: center; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<nav>
  <a href="#" class="nav-logo">Armonia <span>Lashes</span></a>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="#nosotras">Nosotras</a></li>
    <li><a href="#servicios">Servicios</a></li>
    <li><a href="#contacto">Contacto</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>

<section class="hero" id="hero">
  <div class="hero-left">
    <span class="hero-tag">Diseno de Mirada Personalizado</span>
    <h1 class="hero-title">Tu mirada,<br><em>tu poder.</em></h1>
    <p class="hero-sub">Realzamos tu belleza natural con disenos unicos de pestanas. Tecnica, precision y cuidado profesional en cada sesion.</p>
    <div class="hero-actions">
      <a href="#diferenciadores" class="btn-ghost">Conoce mas</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-right" style="overflow:hidden;">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Armonia Lashes" style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:center top; display:block;">
  </div>
</section>

<div class="stats">
  <div class="stat-item fade-in">
    <span class="stat-num">100%</span>
    <span class="stat-label">Personalizacion real</span>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-item fade-in">
    <span class="stat-num">+3 hrs</span>
    <span class="stat-label">Ahorro de maquillaje al dia</span>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-item fade-in">
    <span class="stat-num">1a</span>
    <span class="stat-label">Sesion con resultados visibles</span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- NOSOTRAS -->
<section class="nosotras" id="nosotras">
  <div class="nosotras-left fade-in">
    <span class="section-tag">Nuestra historia</span>
    <h2 class="section-title">Por que nacio<br><em>Armonia Lashes</em></h2>
    <p class="nosotras-lead">Todo comenzo con una frustracion que muchas mujeres conocen bien: despertar cada manana y sentir que algo faltaba.</p>
    <p class="nosotras-story">Valentina, fundadora de Armonia Lashes, paso anos buscando un lugar donde la trataran como individuo y no como un numero mas. Cada estudio de pestanas le entregaba el mismo resultado generico, el mismo estilo de catalogo que no tenia nada que ver con su cara, su personalidad ni su estilo de vida.</p>
    <p class="nosotras-story">En 2021, despues de certificarse en tecnicas avanzadas de extensiones en Bogota y especializarse en morfologia facial, decidio crear el espacio que ella siempre habia querido encontrar: un lugar donde cada mujer llegara y se fuera sintiendose completamente ella misma.</p>
    <p class="nosotras-story">Armonia Lashes no nacio de un trend ni de una moda. Nacio de la conviccion profunda de que la belleza real empieza cuando dejas de imitar y empiezas a expresar. Cada diseno que creamos parte de un estudio serio de tu rostro, tu mirada y tu esencia.</p>
    <p class="nosotras-firma">Valentina Rios, Fundadora</p>
  </div>
  <div class="nosotras-right fade-in" style="padding:0; border-left:none; background:none; overflow:hidden; border-radius:4px;">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Armonia Lashes mirada" style="width:100%; height:100%; min-height:420px; object-fit:cover; object-position:center; display:block; border-radius:4px;">
  </div>
</section>

<!-- DIFERENCIADORES -->
<section class="diferenciadores" id="diferenciadores">
  <div class="dif-header fade-in">
    <span class="section-tag">Por que elegirnos</span>
    <h2 class="section-title">Lo que nos hace <em>unicas</em></h2>
    <p class="dif-lead">No solo aplicamos pestanas. Estudiamos tu armonia facial para crear una mirada que realmente te represente.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="dif-grid">
    <div class="dif-card fade-in">

<script>
  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        var delay = entry.target.dataset.delay || 0;
        setTimeout(function() {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        }, parseInt(delay));
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });

  document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(function(el, i) {
    el.dataset.delay = (i % 4) * 80;
    observer.observe(el);
  });
</script>
